atomic_facts.fact: Pat Gelsinger's full name is Patrick Paul Gelsinger
Pat Gelsinger was born on March 5, 1961
Pat Gelsinger became Intel's CEO on February 15, 2021
Pat Gelsinger's retirement as Intel's CEO was effective December 1, 2024
As of October 1, 2026, Pat Gelsinger is not Intel's CEO
David Zinsner and Michelle Johnston Holthaus were named Intel's interim co-CEOs after Gelsinger stepped down
As of October 1, 2026, Intel is still led by interim co-CEOs David Zinsner and Michelle Johnston Holthaus
